title: Act: Add lighting effect schema variants and author them in bedroom.yaml
description: Add four zod variants to effectSchema and declare the effects in bedroom.yaml, replacing the non-palette ambientLight colour with a palette colour.
acceptance_criteria: effectSchema parses the four new types
bedroom.yaml lists six non-transition effects with PALETTE colours
definition_of_done: Schema and YAML updated; typecheck passes

steps.action: Add four z.object variants to the discriminated union before the transition variant: moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight, vignette.
steps.code:
z.object({ type: z.literal('moonlightShaft'), color: z.string(), alpha: z.number().min(0).max(1), area: boundsSchema }),
z.object({ type: z.literal('lampGlow'), color: z.string(), alpha: z.number().min(0).max(1), x: z.number(), y: z.number(), radius: z.number().positive() }),
z.object({ type: z.literal('doorLight'), color: z.string(), alpha: z.number().min(0).max(1), area: boundsSchema }),
z.object({ type: z.literal('vignette'), color: z.string(), alpha: z.number().min(0).max(1) }),
steps.expected: EffectSpec type includes the four new variants and tsc --noEmit passes in game/

steps.action: Change the ambientLight color from '#ffd9a0' to the palette value '#fdd58a' and insert four entries after it, placed near the window (60,30), lamp (80,120) and door (410,100) objects, using palette hexes moon5 '#cfe0f5', lamp4 '#f9a84a', lamp6 '#fdd58a', indigo1 '#0b0a1e'.
steps.code:
- type: moonlightShaft
    color: '#cfe0f5'
    alpha: 0.18
    area: { x: 60, y: 30, width: 90, height: 200 }
  - type: lampGlow
    color: '#f9a84a'
    alpha: 0.25
    x: 96
    y: 130
    radius: 48
  - type: doorLight
    color: '#fdd58a'
    alpha: 0.5
    area: { x: 410, y: 162, width: 32, height: 2 }
  - type: vignette
    color: '#0b0a1e'
    alpha: 0.45
steps.expected: loadWorld validates the bedroom scene with six non-transition effects
